provenance: Only entries with a source I could verify are included. Everything else is listed in data/curation/TODO.md. These are options to discuss, not recommendations, and 'natural' or 'clean' never means safer.

options.role: Studied as a retinol alternative for fine lines and pigmentation
tradeoffs: In one 12-week trial of 44 volunteers (bakuchiol 0.5% twice daily vs retinol 0.5% once daily), both improved fine wrinkles and pigmentation with no statistically significant difference between groups.
The retinol group had more facial scaling and stinging in that trial.
One small trial is limited evidence. Retinol has a much larger research base, so 'similar' is not 'equal'.
This does not show bakuchiol is suitable in pregnancy or for any particular skin condition; ask a clinician.

source.label: Dhaliwal et al., Br J Dermatol 2019;180:289-296
